title: Public Change Log Hub and semantic versioning
summary: Introduced a public, searchable MyAPES release history and a source-controlled semantic version contract for future releases.
changes: Added the public Change Log Hub with search, release filters, expandable records, current-release navigation, and accessible result feedback.
Added a shared footer version link so guests, public users, and staff can reach the current release record from every application screen.
Added append-only release validation for pull requests and main-branch updates without creating a database-backed editor.
Separated the semantic application version from the immutable deployment commit identity in health and release verification.
affected_areas: Public Change Log Hub and shared application footer
Release metadata validation and continuous integration
Health reporting and immutable release packaging
version_rationale: A backward-compatible minor release establishing a new public capability and the release-management contract for later roadmap work.
validation: Release schema, append-only history, public access, footer consistency, health reporting, filtering behavior, and packaging contracts are covered by automated tests.
Responsive light and dark layouts, keyboard operation, focus visibility, reduced motion, and no-JavaScript readability are included in local acceptance.
known_limitations: Release history is reviewed source-controlled data and has no database editor.
No Git tag, GitHub Release, production deployment, or authenticated production acceptance is included in this release implementation pass.
rollback: Restore the previous application release; its deployment identity remains available through the existing immutable commit and code-rollback process.
provenance: Defined by MyAPES Account issue #20 and implemented as the release foundation for roadmap issue #17.

title: Responsive sidebar and refreshed MyAPES branding
summary: Replaced the shared horizontal navigation with a responsive sidebar and mobile drawer while refreshing the application brand assets.
changes: Introduced one responsive navigation shell for authenticated and guest pages while preserving role-aware routes and theme behavior.
Regenerated browser, progressive-web-app, login, email, and social assets from the approved APES artwork.
Added deterministic brand-asset generation and design quality-assurance evidence.
affected_areas: Shared navigation, mobile drawer, footer, and themes
Browser, progressive-web-app, login, email, and social brand assets
Design quality-assurance tooling and documentation
version_rationale: A backward-compatible minor release with a substantial user-visible navigation and branding improvement.
validation: Automated PHP tests and the production frontend build passed for the merged change.
Desktop light and dark layouts plus mobile open and closed navigation states received browser-based design review.
known_limitations: The release did not change application APIs, database schema, authentication roles, or deployment endpoints.
rollback: Restore the previous shared layout, stylesheet, JavaScript entry point, and generated brand assets.
provenance: This historical record was reconstructed from merged pull request #9 and was not represented by a historical Git tag.

title: Initial Cloudron release activation correction
summary: Corrected first-release activation so an absent current-release link is handled safely.
changes: Changed activation guards to resolve current and previous release targets only when those paths are symbolic links.
Preserved the existing fail-closed release-path checks and immutable activation behavior.
affected_areas: Cloudron release activation and rollback safeguards
version_rationale: A compatible patch correcting the initial activation path without changing the release architecture.
validation: Automated application tests, deployment shell syntax, and an absent-link activation probe passed for the merged correction.
known_limitations: The earlier blocked upload was not accepted as the live release.
rollback: Restore the earlier activation guard if the corrected symbolic-link handling must be withdrawn.
provenance: This historical record was reconstructed from merged pull request #7 and was not represented by a historical Git tag.

title: Continuous-integration application-key correction
summary: Made automated Laravel tests independent from an untracked local environment file.
changes: Added a deterministic non-secret testing key to the PHPUnit environment.
Kept production secrets and runtime environment configuration outside the repository.
affected_areas: Automated PHP test configuration
version_rationale: A compatible patch restoring reliable continuous-integration testing.
validation: The complete automated PHP test suite passed with the corrected test-only configuration.
known_limitations: The correction affected testing only and did not deploy application code by itself.
rollback: Restore the previous PHPUnit environment configuration, accepting that automated tests would again depend on an external application key.
provenance: This historical record was reconstructed from merged pull request #6 and was not represented by a historical Git tag.

title: MyAPES takeover with secure staff identity
summary: Introduced the Naturalist Notebook interface, deterministic local quality assurance, and protected staff sign-in backed by Cloudron identity and directory eligibility.
changes: Added the approved light and dark application interface with role-scoped dashboard attention and local quality-assurance identities.
Added standards-based staff sign-in with protected authorization state and exact directory-group eligibility.
Added periodic directory revalidation, secure local logout behavior, readiness checks, and immutable release activation with rollback.
Added sanitized health and staff-login verification around the release workflow.
affected_areas: Authentication, directory authorization, sessions, and staff logout
Shared application interface and role-scoped dashboard
Release activation, rollback, health, and post-release verification
version_rationale: A backward-compatible minor release introducing major application, identity, and deployment capabilities.
validation: Automated tests covered identity redirects, claims, collisions, denials, role precedence, directory changes, outages, logout, readiness, release gates, and rollback.
Application tests, the frontend build, cache warm-up, script syntax, and public-route availability were reviewed.
known_limitations: Production identity configuration and authenticated acceptance remained controlled human-administrator steps.
rollback: Use the immutable code rollback process and restore the prior application interface and identity integration if release verification fails.
provenance: This historical record was reconstructed from merged pull request #5 and was not represented by a historical Git tag.

title: Mascot-led interface and product direction
summary: Refreshed the shared application interface with a warmer mascot-led visual system and documented product design principles.
changes: Integrated approved brand, browser, progressive-web-app, and social assets.
Added reusable mascot artwork to key entry and dashboard surfaces.
Unified shared styling for navigation, panels, forms, tables, alerts, and the footer.
Added product direction covering users, purpose, personality, anti-references, and accessibility.
affected_areas: Authentication, dashboard, administration, and service screens
Shared layout, branding, and product documentation
version_rationale: A backward-compatible minor release delivering a substantial visual and product-design capability.
validation: The automated PHP test suite passed for the merged interface refresh.
known_limitations: The release concentrated visual behavior in the shared layout and did not change service data contracts.
rollback: Restore the previous shared layout, view styling, documentation, and application-facing brand assets.
provenance: This historical record was reconstructed from merged pull request #4 and was not represented by a historical Git tag.

title: Local quality-assurance and review hardening
summary: Added deterministic local accounts, seeded service records, and repeatable setup paths for end-to-end review.
changes: Added deterministic public, staff, administrator, and superadministrator quality-assurance users and service records.
Added fresh and non-destructive local bootstrap modes for Windows and Unix-like systems.
Added environment-gated local sign-in shortcuts and a role switcher for rapid review.
Documented the local feature matrix and seeded workflows.
affected_areas: Local setup, seeded data, test authentication, and quality-assurance documentation
version_rationale: A compatible patch hardening local review and correcting setup gaps after the application baseline.
validation: Fresh migration and seeding plus the automated PHP test suite passed for the merged change.
known_limitations: Local authentication shortcuts remain strictly limited to local and testing environments.
rollback: Remove the deterministic seed and environment-gated quality-assurance helpers while retaining the underlying application baseline.
provenance: This historical record was reconstructed from merged pull request #2 and was not represented by a historical Git tag.

title: Application baseline and approved branding
summary: Introduced the full Laravel application structure, initial service areas, and the approved MyAPES branding pack.
changes: Added controllers, models, routes, views, configuration, migrations, tests, and local development scripts.
Added role-aware APES CIC, Shelter, and Pet Care areas with the initial account and administration surfaces.
Integrated the approved header, browser, progressive-web-app, and social artwork.
Aligned local setup and Cloudron deployment automation with the expanded application.
affected_areas: Whole MyAPES Laravel application baseline
APES CIC, Shelter, Pet Care, accounts, and administration
Application branding and local/deployment tooling
version_rationale: A backward-compatible minor release introducing the main application baseline and service capabilities.
validation: Repository review covered the complete runnable baseline and approved brand integration.
known_limitations: The initial baseline preceded the later identity, release, and responsive-navigation hardening.
rollback: Restore the earlier deployment-only foundation and remove the introduced application baseline and brand integration.
provenance: This historical record was reconstructed from merged pull request #3 and was not represented by a historical Git tag.

title: Deployment and local setup foundation
summary: Established repeatable Laravel local setup and the first automated Cloudron delivery workflow.
changes: Added Windows and Unix-like local bootstrap and development helpers.
Added automated testing and deployment workflow scaffolding for main-branch and manual runs.
Added guarded remote release steps and deployment documentation.
affected_areas: Local development setup
Continuous integration and Cloudron delivery foundation
Repository operational documentation
version_rationale: The first minor beta release established the repository's development and delivery foundation.
validation: The merged foundation included fail-fast configuration checks and post-restart health verification.
known_limitations: The first workflow was later replaced and hardened as the application architecture matured.
